story.zh: 接纳了吕布的刘备万万没想到对方竟会趁下邳空虚而动手，无奈之下刘备只好采取谋士的建议向曹操求援...
story.en: Having sheltered Lu Bu, Liu Bei never imagined his guest would strike while Xiapi was left vulnerable. Left with no choice, Liu Bei follows his advisor's counsel and turns to Cao Cao for aid...

trigger.zh: 曹操、刘关张、吕布存活。下邳属吕布、小沛属刘备、许昌属曹操。吕布势力至少拥有5名武将。
trigger.en: Cao Cao, Liu Bei, Guan Yu, Zhang Fei, and Lu Bu are alive. Xiapi belongs to Lu Bu, Xiaopei belongs to Liu Bei, and Xuchang belongs to Cao Cao. Lu Bu's Faction has at least 5 Officers.

defy.en: 【<Gao Shun belongs to Lu Bu's Faction><Serve in Cao Cao's Faction or Liu Bei's Faction><Relationship level with Gao Shun reaches Level 2>Ensure Gao Shun survives and recruit him as a Retainer】, 【<Cao Cao or Liu Bei's Faction><Relationship level with Liu Bei reaches Level 2><Diaochan and other female kin belong to Lu Bu's Faction>Have Diaochan, Lu Ji, and other female kin in Lu Bu's Faction join your Family】
